name: Shiva 2.0 Unified Foundation Contract
principle: All Shiva foundations are one authenticated workspace. UI sections can open one another and use the same user-scoped APIs; no foundation bypasses authorization or another user's data boundary.
recovery: authenticated workspace backup/restore through the same authorized APIs

autonomous_agent.chat_history: agent runs are saved as authenticated chats

access.ai_context: Authenticated /api/message receives the same user's Memory, Projects, Tasks and current Project context.

ui.navigation: All user-facing foundations may link to the other sections; the shared session remains the identity boundary.

security.ownership: Every authenticated workspace query/mutation is scoped to req.user.user_id
security.agent: Agent actions use the same authenticated workspace APIs and cannot cross user ownership boundaries
